subject: Testimonial + logo use — timing window, audit evidence, and MSA carveouts
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightops.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@brightops.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood case study / logo + quote request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the quick pilot and the support from your team — we got great traction internally. We'd like to publish a short case study and include: a one-sentence testimonial quote, our company name and logo, and a short blurb mentioning BrightOps as an early adopter. We have a draft attached (BrightOps_CaseStudy_Draft_v1.docx).

Requests / questions:
- Can Redwood confirm we can publicly use your logo?
- Is there an embargo window you need (we were thinking to wait until Nov 15 to coordinate PR)?
- Any compliance evidence or wording you require to be included (e.g., mention of SOC2 scope)?

If this is covered by the MSA / order form we signed, point me to the clause and we can follow your standard process. Happy to run the draft past legal.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Marketing, BrightOps
elena.morales@brightops.com
(415) 555-0199

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightops.com>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@brightops.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood case study / logo + quote request

Hi Elena — great to hear it went well. Thanks for the draft.

Short answers up front:
- Logo & quote: yes, we generally permit logo and short testimonials under the Order Form / publicity section of the MSA but need to confirm exact language and any embargo windows.
- Embargo: Nov 15 works from a product/PM perspective, but legal sometimes asks for a 14-day review window prior to public release.
- Evidence: we ask for any SOC2 / security claims to be accurate — if you reference us running on SOC2-covered infrastructure we may ask for a short statement or evidence to confirm scope.

I'll loop in Marketing (Laura) and Legal (Marissa) to confirm acceptable wording and any required redline. For speed: can you highlight the exact quote you want to use and confirm the logo file you plan to consume?

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm quote & logo file name in the docx (or attach a high-res PNG/SVG)
- Laura: if you can confirm branding guidance and embargo preferences
- Marissa/legal: please advise on any standard publicity carveouts or additional audit evidence needed.

Thanks — happy to move quickly on this.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightops.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@brightops.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood case study / logo + quote request

Hi all — looping in Legal for the redline items. Short note on what we'll need and suggested edits you can accept in the doc:

1) Publicity clause reference: the MSA's current publicity language allows mutual public announcements but requires prior written sign-off. For speed, BrightOps can provide the final quote + logo and we will provide written approval within 7 business days. If you need a faster turnaround, note it here and we'll prioritize.

2) Embargo window: we are OK with Nov 15 publication, provided BrightOps submits the final assets by Nov 1. That gives us the standard 10 business-day legal/marketing review window. If BrightOps needs later edits after Nov 1, the window can slip and launch date will be pushed.

3) Logo usage and marks: please use the official Redwood logo attached in the "Brand_Kit/Logos" folder. We do not permit modifying the mark (color, proportion, or layout) without prior approval. We will provide a white/positive and dark/negative version depending on background.

4) Confidentiality carveouts: if BrightOps requests removal of customer-identifying references or redaction of sensitive metrics, indicate exact fields. We can accept anonymized case studies under a specific addendum but that requires a quick order-form amendment citing the limited disclosure.

5) Audit / compliance statements: BrightOps should not assert Redwood is SOC2-authorized on their behalf. If you want to mention controls, the safer language is: "Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II controls for its production infrastructure" — we can provide a statement or a one-page security summary. If BrightOps requires our SOC2 report as evidence, we'll need an executed NDA / evidence request form and a minimal period to process (we can provide via secure link).

Attachments to include in your next pass: final quote snippet, the exact logo file you plan to use, and any redlines to the case study text.

If BrightOps is ok with the timeline (assets by Nov 1, review & sign-off by Nov 12), we'll confirm Nov 15 as the target.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: MSA_OrderForm_excerpt.pdf (application/pdf)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightops.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood case study / logo + quote request

Quick marketing note — happy to own the brand review and provide the approved logo files. A couple practical items for BrightOps to make the release smooth:

- Please send the final quote in a standalone .txt so we can pull it verbatim into the case study.
- For logos: request SVG + PNG @2x. We prefer the white-on-dark version for your website hero; we'll confirm which to use after we see the layout.
- If BrightOps wants a co-branded social image, provide 1200x628 landscape artwork and we can produce the composite.

On embargo: Nov 15 is fine. Elena, can BrightOps commit to delivering final assets by Nov 1? If yes, I'll schedule a creative review on Nov 3 and legal review on Nov 4 so we can meet the Nov 12 sign-off timeline Marissa suggested.

Laura Bennett
Senior Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
